name: Hailstorm

text.fail: Hail strips every barricade from every location, and each player still in the colony rolls a die: on a 4 or less one of their survivors gets frostbite. No morale is lost.
text.bonus: Two cards beyond the need lift morale by 1.

notes: Clean scan reads in full: Tool symbol, every non-exiled player rolls a die and on 4 or less puts a frostbite wound on one survivor they control, all barricades come off every location, no morale loss. Matches hook crisis.hailstorm.frostbiteRolls.
